name: ParameterMixture

args.name: submodel
args.description: The substitution model as a function of the parameter

args.name: frequencies
args.description: The probabilities of the parameter values, summing to one

title: Mixture model
description: A mixture of substitution models obtained by evaluating `submodel` at each parameter value. Each site uses one resulting component throughout the tree. Component rates are preserved when the mixtures are combined.
